verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists 'metadata filtering' as a feature (moss-gh-1), and the docs make general sub-10ms search latency claims (moss-docs-26). Nothing documents structured filter conditions or shows that filtered queries keep recall and latency intact. missing for 10: documented filter syntax/operators (equality, range, boolean conditions), evidence of how filtering interacts with ANN recall (pre- vs post-filtering), latency figures for filtered queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
